analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the app aims to simplify ethical consumerism, but the ‘grade’ system and reliance on third-party certifications could be more precisely defined.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Decent market size – ethical consumerism is growing, but the reliance on existing certifications suggests limited disruption.
